question: Which among the following peaks is the highest peak of Jharkhand?
solution:
The correct answer is __​Parasnath__

__
 
• Parasnath Hill is the highest peak in Jharkhand state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• It is named after Lord Parshvanatha, the 23rd Tirthankara of the Jain religion.
 
• It is located in the Giridih district of Jharkhand.
 
• The height of Parasnath Hill is about 1365 m.
 
• For Jain people, it is the most important pilgrimage center.
 
• Jain calls the hill "Sammed Sikhar".
 
• Parasnath was the 23rd Tirthankara and the hill was named after him.
 
• Some believe that the 9th Tirthankaras achieved salvation on this hill.
 
• There is a shrine on the hill for each Tirthankara.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Anamudi is the highest peak of the Anaimalai hills.

__
 
• Anaimalai hills are situated in the north of Anamudi.
 
• Anamudi is located in Kerala.
 
• Anamudi is also known as the Everest of South India.
 
• The elevation of Anamudi hill is 2,695 meters.
 
• The name Anamudi means "elephant's head".
 
• General Douglas Hamilton made the first recorded ascent of Anamudi.
 
• Anamudi is the meeting point of Anamalai, Palanimalai, and ealaimalai.

Girnar hills:-

 
• It is a group of mountains situated in the Junagadh district of Gujarat__.
 
• It is a sacred pilgrimage site of both Hindus and Jains and is considered to be older than even the Himalayas.
 
• The highest point in Gujarat, Mt. Girnar has for centuries been one of the most important pilgrimage sites in the state and in all of Western India, with 866 Hindu and Jain temples spread over the 5 summits.
